name: Saru! Get You! 2: Ukki Ukki Disc
summary: The disc contains three slide puzzles that, when completed, unlock the "Saru-Buster" gadget, which is basically just a land version of the Water net. Due to the "Ukki-Ukki" disc not being released outside of Japan, this gadget is not available for Jimmy/Hikaru to use in the international versions.
